SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.package_id, a.slot_id, a.status, a.report_url, a.create_time, p.name AS package_name, p.coach_name, s.course_date, s.time_range FROM course_appointment a LEFT JOIN course_package p ON p.id = a.package_id LEFT JOIN course_slot s ON s.id = a.slot_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
